investigation_notes.Description: The alert was triggered by multiple high-entropy DNS queries under dotnxdomain.net, including sentinel-style subdomains and region identifiers (eu). The root domain is long-established (created 2012) and the subdomain patterns appear consistent with diagnostic/monitoring naming rather than obvious Base64-encoded exfiltration; no decoded sensitive host strings were found. Correlation shows the host has recent legitimate DNS activity and there are no prior similar alerts, so this is assessed as Low Priority due to benign indicators and the mature domain age.
